notes.title: Demo update 0.1.3 - Hotfix

tags.bug: - Fixed a game breaking bug where the compass coordinates wouldn't update;
- Fixed a bug where using items required clicking two times;
- Fixed a bug where zombies would spawn in the floor;
- Fixed a bug where some windows would show an interaction option;
- Fixed a bug in the zombie audio where it would play if the zombie was dead;
- Fixed a collision issue;

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.3

tags.balance_change: - Performance updates: A new system for streaming assets in/out of the world which should improve the performance on multiple systems. Removed all raytracing features, improved garbage collection, adjusted culling distances for certain foliage types, and more;

tags.bug: - Fixed multiple multiplayer issues where the server/client couldn't see what was happening but the client/server could;
- Fixed a bug where the game would infinitely try to spawn zombies but couldn’t, therefore the story wouldn't continue;

tags.feature: - Rebinded the default inventory key to [tab] instead of [i] key and made a function to close the inventory with the same key;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug that let you duplicate items if you ate/drank it from a chest;
- Fixed various sound issues;

tags.feature: - Added fall damage. The player now gets fall damage. Depending on the height the damage will be higher;
- Improved the visuals for the flashlight;
- Added a gamemode selection option (this will be unlocked in the full game);

tags.bug: - Fixed various zombie spawn issues;

tags.feature: - Added a rebinding function for throwing items (default with G key);
- Updated certain POI (points of interest) locations making it more difficult to enter/leave them and more rewarding;
- Reworking the weapon inventory system. A lot of players find it confusing that weapons are in a separate inventory system (press Q for weapons, tab for items). I’m going to combine both features.

- A new weapon: sniper. This feature is already in the game but needs a 3d model. In update 0.1.3 I’ve hidden the item in two locations. If you can find it, have fun with it! Otherwise, it will be fully functional and with a correct model in the next update :)
- Removing the ‘’make new profile’’ function. This function is confusing to players and can be removed;
- Adding a kick + ban system for the multiplayer;
- Reworking the spectating system;
- Adding a different enemy on certain waves (this is story related, players who played the story already know what is coming!)

tags.bug: - There are still a couple of bugs in multiplayer regarding the zombie targeting. These are known and will be fixed, but please mention it when you find one.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.1 & 0.1.2
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 

I've missed the post for the 0.1.1 update so here is two updates in one post. 
I've been working on a couple of new features and fixed a lot of small issues in this demo update. The next update will be the last big update for the demo. Hope you're having fun with the demo so far! 

Update list 0.1.1 : [/p][list][*][p]You can now pick your weapon back up if your inventory is full; [/p][/*][*][p]New feature! Explosives! You can now find, grenades, mines, smokebombs and molotov cocktails. Equip your explosives in the weapon wheel and throw them with your G key. Be careful, some area's contain mines that already been dropped![/p][/*][*][p]Environment updates: A gate at the wall and a church has been added;[/p][/*][*][p]The countdown is removed, wave warnings are now done in the form of audio (church bells) let me know how this plays, if it's clear and/or if this feature needs adjustments;[/p][/*][*][p]The wave system got a couple of difficulty tweaks;[/p][/*][*][p]More zombie spawns in houses and area's;[/p][/*][*][p]More weapons can be found;[/p][/*][*][p]Some minor performance tweaks;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Update list 0.1.2:[/p][p] This patch will fix some spawning issues (zombies didn't spawn correct on multiple locations) and fix some MP UI & sound issues. The spawning stayed in a loop so on the long run could impact performance. This fix will be up in a couple of hours. For the lucky players, the sniper is almost ready for playing, I only need a model (it's now using the rifle model) but I've hidden two temporary snipers in the game. Good luck searching!

If you want to know what the next big update will feature, join the official Discord to find out: 
[url="https://discord.gg/ZUUwNHzDxX"]https://discord.gg/ZUUwNHzDxX[/url]

Thanks for all the great feedback so far! 

- Justin 
[/p]

tags.feature: You can now pick your weapon back up if your inventory is full;

New feature! Explosives! You can now find, grenades, mines, smokebombs and molotov cocktails. Equip your explosives in the weapon wheel and throw them with your G key. Be careful, some area's contain mines that already been dropped!
Environment updates: A gate at the wall and a church has been added;
The countdown is removed, wave warnings are now done in the form of audio (church bells) let me know how this plays, if it's clear and/or if this feature needs adjustments;

tags.balance_change: The wave system got a couple of difficulty tweaks;
More zombie spawns in houses and area's;

tags.bug: This patch will fix some spawning issues (zombies didn't spawn correct on multiple locations) and fix some MP UI & sound issues. The spawning stayed in a loop so on the long run could impact performance.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.0 is out!
notes.content:
[p]Update 0.1.0 is live! [/p][p]I'm so excited to release the next update with everyone! I worked really hard on this update so hopefully you'll like the new content. [/p][p]The new update contains visual updates, performance updates and multiplayer! A detailed list:[/p][list][*][p]Multiplayer: play online or on LAN connection with 3 friends (total of 4 players),[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby chat (MP only),[/p][/*][*][p]Invite friends through Steam (MP only),[/p][/*][*][p]Create a lobby for friends only or password protection (MP only),[/p][/*][*][p]Performance updates, it should load faster on startup now,[/p][/*][*][p]Audio updates on the zombies and the melee weapons now have extra sounds,[/p][/*][*][p]You get updates in your HUD when and what item you picked up,[/p][/*][*][p]Items have a visible stack size, making it clearer how much items you can stack,[/p][/*][*][p]Visual update how much each food, water and heal item adds to your stats,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could use items infinite when used in a chest,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some collision bugs,[/p][/*][*][p]Foliage gained a performance update,
[/p][/*][/list][p]Keep in mind, the multiplayer is still in early stages! It's there so I can fix bugs etc before release and test it with the community [/p][p]If you come across any bugs or issue, please let me know!
[/p][p]Enjoy the new update![/p]

notes.title: Demo version 0.0.2 is available
notes.content:
After great feedback by players I've worked really hard on the first update. The first update contains:
[list]
[*] Improved the pickup system,
[*] Improved interacting with objects and making it more readable which box/cabinet you open,
[*] Fixed a couple of spots in the map where players were able to bypass level-up requirements,
[*] Fixed a bug where putting the settings to low a game crash happened,
[*] Added temporary hints so the player knows a bit better what the objective is or the right button is (visuals for this will improve in later updates),
[*] Lowered the volume of the level-up sound,
[*] Small performance updates (still working on this but hopefully will tackle this more in the updates to come),
[*] Made objectives more readable in the world,
[*] Added a small outline for your mission text so it's better readable (visual will improve more in later updates),
[*] Added an outline on your compass marker for better readability (visual will improve more in later updates),
[*] Main menu music did not loop, now it's looping
[/list]

The game application disk usage is reduced from around 25gb to around 13gb. 

I'll be working on more updates and improvements this weekend and days to come with on the priority list:
[list]
[*] Fixing a bug where you can spam melee to fast.
[*] Fixing first time loading taking longer then expected.
[/list]

Want to stay up to date on the process? Join the official Discord:
https://discord.gg/ZUUwNHzDxX

Thanks for the amazing feedback so far. I've seen some people with bad experiences but also a lot who enjoyed the demo and played it for more then 2 hours exploring the game! Amazing!

notes.title: The demo for the game will release on May 22 - 2025!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Hk3Rj1z1soQ;full][/previewyoutube]

In this demo you can play the first 30 minutes of the game: The Left Behind. The demo features a handcrafted post-apocalyptic world. Explore a typical Dutch open-world landscape at daytime and beware of hordes of enemies coming in at night. Loot and hunt to survive. Each night, the game becomes increasingly challenging. Keep track of your highscore and try to survive as many nights as possible and/or play through an immersive and mysterious story!

[b]Features[/b]
- Shoot, loot and survive your way through this open world.
- Unlock new areas and weapons while playing the game.
- Encounter various enemies and animals in the world.
- Explore an unique section of the world.
- Unlock various melee and ranged weapons.
- Immerse yourself in the first 30 minutes of a mysterious story.
- Enter and explore every building.


[b]The full game will feature[/b]
- The complete story.
- Steam achievements.
- A solo mode and a co-op mode where you can play the game with up to four (4) players.
- The complete map.
- More buildings to explore.
- An epic boss battle.
- And more!
